description: Return a workflow run's logs plus a failure summary. Always includes run metadata (number, workflow, event, ref, sha), per-job and per-step status / exit code / duration, `failedSteps` (`job / step`) and `testFailures` (failing test names, read from each step's structured results parsed before its log was cut, or the reason they cannot all be named; null when no job failed). `testFailures.details` marks each failure `flaky` (an active forensic label with a repro, from another run — with its label and flip rate), `known` (also failing on the default branch's latest run), `infra` (timed out under load) or `new`, with its file, message, the targeted retry's verdict and this run's determinism-forensics finding (`forensic`: class, label, variable, repro) when they ran. A step whose log was cut carries `fullLog` (artifact download of the uncut output). `step` (a step name or 1-based position within its job) returns only that step's stdout/stderr; `tail_lines` keeps the last N lines. The full per-job logs are included only when neither is given. JSON-friendly companion to the ZIP-download endpoint.

run_id.description: The run's id, or a unique leading part of it (8+ hex characters)

step.description: Only this step's logs: its name (exact, else substring, case-insensitive) or its 1-based position within its job

tail_lines.description: Keep only the last N lines of each returned log (max 5000)

name: gluecron_get_workflow_logs
